name: What is the typical cost of AEO services for a real estate agent?
description: AEO costs for real estate agents vary based on project scope, from a few hundred dollars for audits to over a thousand monthly for comprehensive services.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of AEO services for a real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AEO services for real estate agents varies widely based on the scope and complexity of the project. Factors influencing cost include the number of properties or agents to optimize, the volume of existing content requiring optimization, ongoing content creation needs, and the level of reporting and analysis desired. Basic AEO audits and strategy development might start at a few hundred dollars, while comprehensive, ongoing optimization packages with content creation can range from several hundred to over a thousand dollars per month. A customized quote is usually provided after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO costs for real estate agents vary based on project scope, from a few hundred dollars for audits to over a thousand monthly for comprehensive services.
